description: Margin financing (融資) and short-sale (融券) balances for a Taiwan-listed stock, with the day's buys, sells, covering and the exchange quota. Rising margin balance means leveraged retail buying; rising short balance against a flat price is the classic squeeze setup. Answers "margin balance on 2330", "how heavily shorted is this Taiwanese stock".

symbols.description: One or more Taiwan securities, comma-separated. Codes, English abbreviations and Chinese names all resolve. Up to 20 per call.
